mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Harriet Park with the moon currently in a waxing gibbous phase. It is 52 degrees outside, and we are looking at an overnight low of 48 degrees with no rain expected.

City residents should note that the Verona Senior Center is currently offering meal services including grab-and-go options and home-delivered meals, while the public works department reminds everyone to sign up for the city newsletter to stay updated on local utility and infrastructure news.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can join others for trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market takes over Hometown Junction Park, followed by trivia night at the Bogey Factory and live music series at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police report, on September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for operating while intoxicated, second offence, after a vehicle crash on Shooting Star Road.

Today's flavor of the day is available now, but please note that the Verona location is closing soon in 51 minutes, so be sure to plan your visit accordingly if you want a treat before they close for the night.
